calculation.description: During elevated cross-asset five-day volatility dispersion, rank assets by negative three-day return scaled by each asset's trailing 20-day volatility. The activation test and all inputs are lagged to prevent look-ahead. Factor is intended for ten-trading-day forward returns.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2027-02-25 (valid active dates through 2027-02-10 for 10d forward returns)
validation.regime_notes: Strong aggregate result is concentrated in 2025 (10d IC 0.16260, ICIR 0.5089); 2027-to-date is negative (10d IC -0.08845, ICIR -0.3003), so conservative sizing and immediate rolling revalidation are required. 2020-2024 had insufficient active observations under the strict activation rule.
